_comment: Tier-2: PoroNewmarkQuasistaticUPlScheme takes (theta_u, theta_p, beta, gamma) — thetas FIRST — and the scheme additionally requires several ProcessInfo entries, with RAYLEIGH_ALPHA/BETA only existing once StructuralMechanicsApplication is imported. Pitfall (kratos.poromechanics #5). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The four-argument constructor accepts the documented defaults (0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.5) and rejects a three-argument call, so the arity is pinned; every ProcessInfo variable the claim names resolves through KratosGlobals.GetVariable once SMA is loaded. The claim's warning that a WRONG ARGUMENT ORDER still runs is why arity is the only thing a fixture can check here — swapping thetas and beta/gamma is silently accepted. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
